scope: frontend-owned selected slot/profile preparation for an existing canonical Character Save
source_order: Require the selected slot, same-Character direct Save slot field, and actual SetSlot receipt.
Read dh2_NNN.savegame through ApplicationSaveFilesOwnerV61::read_save, which flushes matching Application jobs.
Construct CampaignSaveProfileV45 from the exact same files()->services() and jobs() pair.
Require the profile cache bytes to equal the read_save receipt exactly.
Populate CharacterProfileBootstrapInputsV59 with the same Save/Load, typed file receipt, profile, slot, and prior SetSlot receipt; existing V59 owns Load1/2/4 ordering.

checks: selected file read and exact CampaignSaveProfile cache match
same Character Save/Load and direct Save slot; no PlayerInfo preview Save

limits: The helper does not create or persist a new indexed profile; NativeCreateSaveSlot must already have written it.
The caller must supply the actual source SetSlot receipt and source callback, plus genuine Character/Save reader dependencies.
This result is a prepared bootstrap input/profile cache only; it does not claim Load1/2/4, Gear readiness, full InitPost, or live menu acceptance.
